summary: Space outside the border. auto margins absorb free space.
details: Vertical margins between blocks collapse into the larger one. In flex and grid there is no collapsing, and an auto margin pushes the item away from its neighbours.

values.note: Centers a block that has a width.
In flex/grid: soaks up free space on all sides.

gotcha: Use margin-left: auto on a flex item to push it (and everything after it) to the end.
